# Pinned firewood advancement fixtures

These six JSON files are copied unchanged from Tinkers' Construct
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`:

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2/src/generated/resources/data/tconstruct/advancements/recipes

Slab and stairs files are under `building_blocks/common/firewood/`;
fences are under `decorations/common/firewood/`. `sha256.json` records the
source bytes. Native adaptations change only the recipe IDs and Horizon's
recipe-unlocked predicate field.
